text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear intro body conclusion progression","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured into an opening, supporting body paragraphs, and a concluding wrap-up."},{"evidence":"“The main cause of automobile collisions is distracted drivers… I experience this first-hand”","quality":"development with examples","description":"It supports its claims with a more developed real-world example instead of mostly restating the article."},{"evidence":"“The main reason that it is hard for me to agree…” followed by reasons","quality":"argument clarity","description":"The writer states a position and then explains the main objection in a more focused way."},{"evidence":"“If I'm eating a burger and fries while watching a movie…”","quality":"specific reasoning","description":"It uses a concrete scenario to show why partial automation could still be dangerous."},{"evidence":"“When car crashes are one of the leading causes of death…”","quality":"conclusion","description":"The ending more effectively restates the central concern and leaves the reader with a clear final judgment."}]}
